With the launch of Age Adaptive Clearing Serum, the #1 Professional Acne Brand offers a solution to the choice adults have long been told they have to make: treat the acne, or treat the aging
SAN RAMON, Calif. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Face Reality Skincare, the award-winning, professional acne skincare brand, today introduced Age Adaptive Clearing Serum , its first clinical-grade, multi-layered retinoid serum, clinically tested and formulated for acne-prone, aging skin. Powered by patent-pending Beta-ret (Î²-ret) Technologyâ¢, it maintains clear skin while helping target early signs of aging in one acne-safe step.
For adults who have worked to get clear, the serum answers a question the acne industry has largely left open: how to address early signs of aging without risking a return of breakouts. It is designed to integrate seamlessly into the Face Reality Clear Skin Method â¢, the clinically proven professional protocol behind the brand's results for more than two decades â as the next step for clients who have reached clear, prescribed and guided by a certified skincare professional.
Acne and visible aging often arrive at the same time because they frequently share a hormonal root cause. Stress, pregnancy, perimenopause and other hormonal shifts can trigger breakouts at exactly the point adults begin addressing early signs of aging. The two have long been treated as competing problems. While retinoids have long been a cornerstone of anti-aging skincare, many products formulated for aging skin can be too rich or pore-clogging for acne-prone individuals, creating a frustrating tradeoff between managing breakouts and addressing visible signs of aging. Age Adaptive Clearing Serum was developed to remove that trade-off.
"Many of my patients think acne is just for the teen years. Sadly, that is not true," said Angela Lamb, MD , Board-Certified Dermatologist & Associate Professor of Dermatology. "Stress, a change in hormones, or a change in life stage can all trigger acne â and often does at exactly the moment people start thinking about aging. That is why it is so important to have products on hand that can address your acne at any stage of life."
"Our Certified Skincare Professionals have spent more than two decades helping clients get clear and stay clear," said Jeremy Soine , CEO of Face Reality. "Age Adaptive Clearing Serum is a clinically tested innovation that lets them take a client further â addressing early signs of aging without putting the clear skin they worked so hard for at risk. We are proud to give our skincare professionals and their clients a product that serves them at every stage."
Age Adaptive Clearing Serum works on three levels of the skin in a single acne-safe step:
At the surface alpha hydroxy acids (AHAs): L-mandelic and lactic acids gently exfoliate to support smoother-looking skin while staying tolerable for acne-prone and sensitized skin.

Over time Beta-ret (Î²-ret) Technologyâ¢: A patent-pending, next-generation retinoid supports cellular renewal that helps target signs of early aging.

In clinical testing, the serum was shown to clinically improve acne severity by 12 weeks 1 . 97% of panelists saw clearer skin after 12 weeks 1 , 94% showed clinical improvement in fine lines and wrinkles after 8 weeks 2 , and 93% saw smoother skin in the same period 2 .
A certified skincare professional introduces the serum once a client has reached clear. It is applied in the evening after cleansing and before moisturizer and built gradually to nightly use â developed for clear clients who have historically avoided retinoids and anti-aging routines for fear of triggering a relapse.
